milestones.claim: Record the exact 16 Proof-or-Stop prompt filenames and current template hashes.
milestones.doneMeans: A reproducible baseline artifact lists all 16 prompt roles, source filenames, and current template hashes, and a verification command proves the count and hashes match the registry/source.

milestones.claim: Capture current lattice agent_prompt output for every role as comparison artifacts.
milestones.doneMeans: All 16 roles have stored agent_prompt output snapshots or a reproducible artifact that can regenerate/compare the output for later prompt migrations.

milestones.claim: Produce the role-overlap matrix for all 16 prompts.
milestones.doneMeans: A matrix records each prompt phase, commands, direct file access, output artifact, current status, overlap category, and owner boundary.

milestones.claim: Add a regression check for legacy verification vocabulary in active non-legacy prompts.
milestones.doneMeans: A mechanical check fails when an active non-legacy prompt uses testIntent or TEST_CASE_REVIEW without an explicit legacy marker, and the check passes on the current baseline.

milestones.claim: Add a regression check for direct story-file write instructions in prompts.
milestones.doneMeans: A mechanical check flags prompt instructions requiring direct writes under docs/story unless explicitly grandfathered because no CLI command exists, and the check passes on the current baseline.
